summary.text: Clarissa Cervantes is the Democratic candidate for California State Assembly District 58 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Leticia Castillo (R).
She has represented Ward 2 on the Riverside City Council since July 2021 and is not seeking re-election to that seat in 2026.

paragraphs.text: Clarissa Cervantes won the June 8, 2021 general election for Riverside City Council Ward 2 with 52.1 percent of the vote and assumed office on July 13, 2021.
Her current council term ends in 2026.
Cervantes ran for California State Assembly District 58 in 2024, finishing second in the March 5 primary and losing the November 5 general election to Leticia Castillo, 50.2 percent to 49.8 percent.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary alongside Castillo, who now holds the seat.
